messages:
Nina (CSM): Quick heads-up — VortexData is expanding into two new internal teams (quality-monitoring, in-product-search). Tom says pilot starts next week and they expect a sustained ~2x token/day increase plus higher embedding volume. Asking for guidance on Dedicated vs hosted and quick perf knobs.
Tom (VortexData): Confirming. Current avg ~600k tokens/day, expect ~1.2M during pilot; embeddings requests could add ~200k embed units/day. Need p95 <350ms for search. Also want a short list of best-practice prompt + caching to reduce cost.
Elise (Solutions Eng): We should run a 72h canary on a small Dedicated pool routed only for search traffic. Request traces and typical prompt lengths please (just anonymized). Recommend prefix cache for search and an aggressive batching profile.
Ravi (Infra): Early ops estimate: for seq ~512 and concurrency ~15, 1 GPU node with tuned batching should be fine for initial canary. Suggest test config:
```
batching:
 max_batch_size: 48
 max_wait_ms: 50
cache:
 enable_prefix_kv: true
```
Marta (RevOps): Renewal note: their renewal conversation is in ~5 weeks. Tom mentioned pricing sensitivity if we push Dedicated. I'll prepare a 90-day trial + commit sketch and share numbers.
Tom (VortexData): We've uploaded anonymized logs and a short histogram to the support portal. No PII in traces.
OpsBot: Ticket #CS-4901 created: "VortexData expansion - search & quality pilot: canary + embedding eval" Assigned: Elise, Ravi. Due: 2 business days.
Nina (CSM): Action items: 1) Elise -> canary plan + replay steps by EOD; 2) Ravi -> cost + ops checklist; 3) Marta -> renewal trial terms; 4) Tom -> confirm embed eval set uploaded. Kickoff scheduled Thu 11am PT. :calendar: :white_check_mark:
